_sizing_note: required; half_compounding: the book is sized on starting_capital less the drawdown of its cumulative settled net P&L from its running peak, never above starting_capital; starting_capital must equal initial_capital
_equity_slow_rule_note: required; on the book's first sleeve a negative combined forecast of these symbols stands only when the scaled forecast of every pair named is negative, and is 0 otherwise
_carry_note: optional, off when absent or at weight 0 (trade-ngin #185; Carver, Advanced Futures Trading Strategies, strategies ten and eleven): weight is the carry style's share of the first sleeve's forecast weights (0.4 is the book's, trend 0.6), from 0 to 1; spans the EWMA smoothing spans in business days, fastest first; scalar the forecast scalar. On, an instrument's forecast is FDM x ((1 - weight) x the average of its trend speeds + weight x the average of its carry spans), capped at 20, the FDM table 52's for its number of rules; raw carry is read from the held contract's and its roll-cycle neighbour's closes of the same date, so it needs per_contract_rolls true and a book of one TrendFollowingStrategy sleeve. Shipped at weight 0: the strategy is the trend strategy to the last stored digit
_covariance_history_prices_note: daily closes per symbol the PortfolioManager keeps for the optimiser covariance, one per date, oldest dropped first; absent means 756 (the trend sleeve own cap); at least 2. The cap counts each symbol's own dates before the dates are aligned, so the covariance window is the dates every symbol shares inside the span of the densest symbol (the one with the most dates a week): a symbol that prints on fewer days contributes fewer than this many dates to it
_covariance_stale_dates_note: how many dates of the union of the covariance symbols' dates a symbol's last close may trail the newest before the optimiser leaves it out of the date intersection (its column becomes the guarded 0.01 variance, WARN COVARIANCE_STALE_PARTICIPANT); at exactly this many it stays; absent means 5; a whole number of at least 0, e.g. 3 to leave out a symbol more than three dates stale
_per_contract_rolls_note: optional, off when absent; true makes the futures bars come from the per-contract roll rule (include/trade_ngin/data/contract_rolls.hpp: the held contract's own bar on the vendor's grid, rolls by HD's 2026-10-23 rule) instead of the vendor's .v.0 series. Read by the four futures runners (data/per_contract_source.hpp); needs futures_data.contract_ohlcv_1d with expiration filled, and the desk's morning run then also waits for the per-contract pull's ops.data_ready row
_per_contract_switch_bar_note: read only with per_contract_rolls true (HD 2026-10-23 ruling 19): the bar handed out on a vendor switch bar the next bar has not confirmed yet. "held" (absent means held): the held contract's own bar. "vendor": the bar of the contract the vendor switched to, its one-bar strays included. Booked P&L and the roll legs are the same either way; the price levels read on that bar (sizing, marks, notional, the overlay) and the session classifier's reading of it, so the consumed history, can differ
